test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A lot has been learnt from my experiences.

options.text: I will learn a lot from my experiences.
I would learn a lot from my experiences.
I have learnt a lot from my experiences.
I will have learnt a lot from my experiences.

solution:
The correct answer is **"I have learnt a lot from my experiences"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Let's see the sentence in active voice:

__
 
• **A lot has been learnt from my experiences* (active voice) ***

 
 
• ***​***I have learnt a lot from my experiences​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's see the rules of the active voice:

 
• 
 
In the*** active voice, ***the subject is performing an action

 
 
• 
 
***Eg.*** The dog chases the ball. 

 
 
 
 
• Notice how the subject,* dog,* is performing* the action,* *chase*, on *the target of the action, ball.*
 
• This is a simple, direct example of the *active voice.*
